decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 2 - The proposed health centre (with pharmacy) development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposal contained in the application and the plans submitted therewith and approved by the local planning authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the local planning before the health centre (with pharmacy) is being used.

Condition : 3 - The proposed housing block development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted herewith and approved by the local planning authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the local planning authority before the housing block building is being used.

Condition : 4 - No development of the health centre (with Pharmacy) building shall take place until samples of the materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the hereby permitted buildings health centre with pharmacy building have been submitted to and approved in writing by the local planning authority.

Condition : 5 - No development of the housing block building shall take place until samples of the materials to be used in the construction of the extensional surfaces of the hereby permitted housing block building have been submitted to and approved in writing by the local planning authority.

Condition : 6 - No demolition or construction work shall take place on the site except between the hours of 8.00am            to 18.00pm             on Mondays to Friday and   8.30am        to 13.00pm          on Saturdays and none shall take place on Sundays and Public Holidays without the prior agreement of the Local Planning Authority.

Condition : 7 - Before commencement of operations, a scheme shall be submitted to and approved by the Local Planning Authority to cover the following matters:(i)	any external illumination of the site(ii)	measures to ensure that all mud and other loose materials are not carried on the wheels and chassis of any vehicles leaving the site; and(iii)	measures to minimise dust nuisance caused by the operations and to ensure that no dust or other debris is carried on to the adjoining properties.The scheme so approved should be fully implemented.
Condition : 8 - No additional flank windows or other glazed openings shall be formed in any wall of the developments hereby approved without the prior written consent of the Local Planning Authority.

Condition : 9 - A splay of 2.4m x 2.4m shall be provided on each side of the access, the depth measured from the back of the footway and the widths outwards from the edges of the access, and no fence, wall or other obstruction to visibility exceeding 0.6m in height above the surface of the adjoining highway shall be erected within the areas of such splays.

Condition : 10 - No development of the health centre (with pharmacy building) shall take place until full details of both hard and soft landscaping works have been submitted to and approved in writing by the local planning authority and these works shall be carried out as approved.  These details shall include finished levels or contours, means of enclosure; car parking layouts; other vehicle and pedestrian access and circulations areas; hard surfacing material; minor artefacts and structures (eg. Furniture, play equipment, refuse or other storage units, sings, lighting etc); proposed and exiting functional services above and below ground (eg drainage power, communications cables, pipelines etc. indicating lines, manholes, supports etc); retained historic landscape features and proposal for restoration, where relevant.  Soft landscape works shall include (planting plans; written specifications (including cultivation and other operations associated with plant and grass establishment); schedules of plant, noting species, plant sizes and proposed number/densities where appropriate; implementation programme).

Condition : 11 - No development of the housing block shall take place until full details of both hard and soft landscaping works relating to the housing block have been submitted to and approved in writing by the local planning authority and these works shall be carried out as approved.  These details shall include finished levels or contours, means of enclosure; car parking layouts; other vehicle and pedestrian access and circulations areas; hard surfacing material; minor artefacts and structures (eg. Furniture, play equipment, refuse or other storage units, sings, lighting etc); proposed and exiting functional services above and below ground (eg drainage power, communications cables, pipelines etc. indicating lines, manholes, supports etc); retained historic landscape features and proposal for restoration, where relevant.  Soft landscape works shall include (planting plans; written specifications (including cultivation and other operations associated with plant and grass establishment); schedules of plant, noting species, plant sizes and proposed number/densities where appropriate; implementation programme)

Condition : 12 - No development of the health centre (with pharmacy) building shall take place until there has been submitted to and approved in writing by the local planning authority a plan indicating the positions, design, materials and type of boundary treatment to be erected in relation to the health centre (with pharmacy) building.  The boundary treatment shall be completed before the health centre (with pharmacy) building is occupied.  Development shall be carried out in accordance with the approved details.

Condition : 13 - No development of the housing block shall take place until there has been submitted to and approved in writing by the local planning authority a plan indicating the positions, design, materials and type of boundary treatment to be erected in relation to the housing block.  The boundary treatment shall be completed before the housing block is occupied.  Development shall be carried out in accordance with the approved details.

Condition : 14 - The developer shall submit a Car Park Management Plan for the health centre (with pharmacy) building for approval to the local planning authority and these plans will need to be approved in writing prior to first occupation of the health centre (with pharmacy) building.  The Car Park Management Plan shall include, but is not limited to, details of any restricted parking bays and permit/pay and display schemes introduced and methods proposed to enforce and managed such schemes.  The Car Park Management Plan, as approved, shall be implement and thereafter maintained in operation unless any variation is agreed in writing by the local planning authority.

Condition : 15 - The developer shall submit a Car Park Management Plan for the housing block for approval to the local planning authority and these plans will need to be approved in writing prior to first occupation of the housing block.  The Car Park Management Plan shall include, but is not limited to, details of any restricted parking bays and permit/pay and display schemes introduced and methods proposed to enforce and managed such schemes.  The Car Park Management Plan, as approved, shall be implement and thereafter maintained in operation unless any variation is agreed in writing by the local planning authority.

Condition : 16 - The Health Centre building hereby approved shall be used for these purposes only and for no other purpose (including any other purpose in Class D1 of the Schedule to the Town and Country Planning (Use Classes) Order 1987, or in any provision equivalent to that Class in any statutory instrument revoking and re-enacting that Order with or without modification).
Condition : 17 - No fans, louvres, ducts or other external plant shall be installed without the prior approval of the Local Planning Authority.

Condition : 18 - The health centre (with pharmacy) building herby permitted shall not be begun until details of the arrangements for storing of waste and recycled materials in relation to the health centre (with pharmacy) building have been submitted to and approved by the local planning authority.  The arrangements for storing waste and recycled materials shall not be carried out otherwise than in accordance with any approval given and shall be completed before any part of the health centre (with pharmacy) accommodation hereby permitted is occupied and shall be permanently retained thereafter.

Condition : 19 - The housing block building hereby permitted shall not be begun until details of the arrangements for storing of waste and recycled materials in relation to the housing block have been submitted to and approved by the local planning authority.  The arrangements for storing waste and recycled materials shall not be carried out otherwise than in accordance with any approval given and shall be completed before any part of the housing block accommodation hereby permitted is occupied and shall be permanently retained thereafter.

Condition : 20 - Before the residential development is commenced a scheme for protecting the proposed residential accommodation from excessive external noise shall be submitted to and approved by the local planning authority and any works which form part of such a scheme shall be completed before any part of the development is first occupied or used.

Condition : 21 - The internal noise environment of the residential element shall conform to BS8233 reasonable to good design range and the Health Care Centre shall conform to Health Technical Memorandum 2045.

Condition : 22 - Before the health centre (with pharmacy) development commences details of sightlines at the point of access to the public highway shall be submitted to and approved by the local planning authority and the health centre (with pharmacy) development shall be carried out in accordance with the details.

Condition : 23 - Before the housing block development commences details of sightlines at the point of access to the public highway shall be submitted to and approved by the local planning authority and the housing block development shall be carried out in accordance with the details.

Condition : 24 - Before health centre (with pharmacy) development commences, details of facilities for the loading, unloading and turning of vehicles clear of the public highway in relation to the health centre (with pharmacy) shall be submitted to and approved by the local planning authority and implemented.

Condition : 25 - Before the housing block development commences details of facilities for the loading, unloading and turning of vehicles clear of the public highway in relation to the housing block shall be submitted to and approved by the local planning authority and implemented.

Condition : 26 - Before the health centre (with pharmacy) development hereby permitted is commenced a scheme indicating the provision to be made for disabled people to gain access to the health centre shall have been submitted to and approved in writing by the local planning authority.  The agreed scheme shall be implemented before the health centre (with pharmacy) development hereby permitted is brought into use.have been submitted to and approved in writing by the local planning authority.  The agreed scheme shall be implemented before the housing block development hereby permitted is brought into use.

Condition : 27 - Before the housing block development hereby permitted is commenced a scheme indicating the provision to be made for disabled people to gain access to the apartment block shall have been submitted to and approved in writing by the local planning authority.  The agreed scheme shall be implemented before the housing block development hereby permitted is brought into use.
Condition : 28 - Mechanical ventilation, within the hereby approved buildings, should be installed at any receptor that exceeds the NO2 annual mean objective of 40?gm-3.
Condition : 29 - The apartment building envelope shall comprise of acoustic secondary glazing coupled with thermal double glazing and comparable wall treatment.

Condition : 30 - Before any plant and/or machinery is used on the premises, it shall be enclosed with sound-insulating material and mounted in a way which will minimise transmission of structure borne sound in accordance with a scheme to be approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority.

Condition : 31 - No development shall take place until details regarding the proposed bottle store, including information relating to the items stored, have been submitted to and approved by the Local Planning authority.

Condition : 32 - The construction of a site drainage system covering the area of the site to be developed into a heath centre (with pharmacy) shall be carried out in accordance with details submitted to and approved in writing by the local planning authority before the heath centre (with pharmacy) development commences.

Condition : 33 - The construction of a site drainage system covering the area of the site to be developed into a housing block shall be carried out in accordance with details submitted to and approved in writing by the local planning authority before the housing block development commences.

Condition : 34 - Before the development hereby permitted commences:a. The site shall be investigated by a competent person to identify the extent and nature of contamination. A detailed site investigation report shall be prepared and submitted to the LPA for comment. The report should include a tiered risk assessment of the contamination based on the proposed end use of the site.b. A scheme for decontamination of the site shall be submitted to the LPA, for written approval.  Before the development hereby permitted is first occupied:c. The LPA shall be notified immediately if additional contamination is discovered during the course of the development. A competent person shall assess the additional contamination, and shall submit appropriate amendments to the scheme for decontamination in writing to the LPA for approval.  The agreed scheme for decontamination, including amendments, must be fully implemented and a written validation (closure) report submitted to the LPA for approval."

Condition : 35 - No development shall commence until details of a scheme for the implementation of traffic calming measures shown on plan JNL5765-T-08 B have been submitted to and approved by the Council in writing.  No occupation of the development shall take place until the traffic calming measures have been fully implemented in accordance with the approved details unless otherwise agreed in writing by the Council."

Condition : 36 - Lighting schemes required during construction and for the completed development shall be of flat glass, full cut off design, mounted horizontally, and shall ensure that there is no light spill above horizontal.

Condition : 37 - Development of the heath centre (with pharmacy) shall not commence until a bird hazard management plan has been submitted to and approved in writing by the local planning authority.  The submitted plan shall include details of: management of any roofs on buildings within the heath centre (with pharmacy) which may be attractive to nesting, roosting and loafing birds (possible different management strategies during breeding season and outside the breeding season.  The bird hazard management plans shall be implement as approved at the time the heath centre (with pharmacy) building is first occupied.  No subsequent alterations to the plan are to take place unless first submitted to and approved in writing to the local planning authority.

Condition : 38 - Development of the housing block shall not commence until a bird hazard management plan has been submitted to and approved in writing by the local planning authority.  The submitted plan shall include details of: management of any roofs on buildings within the housing block development which may be attractive to nesting, roosting and loafing birds (possible different management strategies during breeding season and outside the breeding season.  The bird hazard management plans shall be implement as approved at the time the housing block building is first occupied.  No subsequent alterations to the plan are to take place unless first submitted to and approved in writing to the local planning authority.
description: Variation of the conditions  planning permission reference 01341/D/P2 for the demolition of existing garages and the erection of a health centre with pharmacy and new housing block consisting of 16 flats with associated parking and landscaping to allow for the health centre to be built prior to the housing development
